title: Track returned shipments (RTO) from nothing
persona: Sends 40 to 50 cash-on-delivery parcels a day. Types short Hinglish lines from a phone, decides quickly, and wants the warehouse boy to mark a returned parcel with one tap. First thinks a separate RTO status would be neat, and drops the idea as soon as a single tick is explained.
opening: shipments me RTO track karna hai

facts.what RTO means here: courier ne parcel wapas bhej diya kyunki customer ne liya nahi
facts.what a shipment with nothing marked mean: khali matlab RTO nahi hua, delivery normal hai ya abhi raste me hai
facts.who marks it: warehouse wala ladka, jab parcel wapas aata hai
facts.what to see: is mahine kitne RTO hue, aur ek filter jisse sirf RTO wale dikhe
facts.a status with more steps: nahi, bas RTO hua ya nahi

success: Luke talks first and asks what a shipment with nothing marked means, or says plainly what he will take it to mean
RTO is one yes/no tick that is either ticked or left blank, never filled in as No
there is a filter that shows only the RTO shipments
there is a count of RTO shipments
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a separate RTO status field beside the tick
a rule that writes a default value into every row
two fields for the same fact
a written screen when the table does it
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
